description: This file defines CLI commands for managing roles in the Mattermost server, including showing role details, assigning users to roles, and unassigning users from roles.

methods.name: prettyRole
methods.description: Formats role information into a readable string, including permissions and usage details.

methods.name: showRoleCmdF
methods.description: Handles the 'show' command to display role details.

methods.name: assignUsersCmdF
methods.description: Handles assigning users to a role.

methods.name: unassignUsersCmdF
methods.description: Handles unassigning users from a role.
